options.description: I don't touch it. Best if this is your own in-progress work, or another session is still editing it — committing now could land something half-finished.
options.label: Leave it alone

options.description: I stage it, write a commit message describing the generation-dir/detached-job design, and push to main. Tests are green, so it's safe to land.
options.label: Commit and push it

options.description: I read the whole diff carefully and report anything that looks wrong or risky before we decide whether to land it.
options.label: Review it first, then decide
